parse.title: Snake Princess
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 11 - Seven Deadly Sins Update Part 1

Overview

Snake Princess is a MythicalMythical. She could only be obtained from clearing Room 100 in Infinity Mansion and opening the Love Star. Players who achieved a rank of Master or higher by the end of the 2nd season were automatically given her shiny version.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
